description: Implementation of the InterfaceStackClientReqHandler class, which manages interface stack client requests, including get/set operations, initialization, and update notifications within a TR-069 host interface context.

classes.name: InterfaceStackClientReqHandler
classes.description: A singleton class managing interface stack client requests, including get/set operations, callback registration, and update checking.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the handler, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the current number of interface stack entries to zero.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler; currently a no-op returning true.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: De-initializes the handler by closing all interface stack instances.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set requests; currently not supported, returns NOT_HANDLED.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for number of entries or attributes like HigherLayer and LowerLayer.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Retrieves notification enable status for a parameter.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Sets notification enable status for a parameter.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for update notifications.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for interface stack updates and triggers callbacks for add/remove or value changes.
